items.prompt: A Moscow street at dusk in the near future: among the hurrying crowd several passers-by have stopped dead at different points on the pavement, each looking up or around in wonder as if noticing something nobody else sees.

alt.ru: Московская улица в сумерках недалёкого будущего: среди спешащей толпы несколько прохожих замерли в разных местах и с удивлением оглядываются.
alt.en: A Moscow street at dusk in the near future: in the hurrying crowd several passers-by have stopped dead and are looking around in surprise.
alt.pt: Uma rua de Moscou ao anoitecer num futuro próximo: na multidão apressada, vários pedestres pararam de repente e olham em volta, surpresos.
alt.es: Una calle de Moscú al anochecer en un futuro próximo: entre la multitud apresurada varios transeúntes se han detenido en seco y miran alrededor, sorprendidos.
